preconditions.description: The number of grooms n is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The number of times the princess says «Oh...» a is between 0 and 15 inclusive.
The number of times the princess exclaims «Wow!» b is between 0 and 15 inclusive.
The number of grooms n is greater than the sum of a and b.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(t) == n and all(1 <= ti <= 50000 for ti in t))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a sequence of n integers where each integer is between 1 and 50000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or sum(1 for i in range(1, n) if t[i] > max(t[:i])) == a
postconditions.description: The number of times the princess says «Oh...» is exactly a.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or sum(1 for i in range(1, n) if t[i] > sum(t[:i])) == b
postconditions.description: The number of times the princess exclaims «Wow!» is exactly b.
